annotations.title: Sign in with a work email

description: Signs in to TeamOnly on this computer. Call it with "email" first: TeamOnly emails that address a 6-digit code. Ask the person for the code, then call again with "code". If their company is new, the result says so; then use start_free (one app, 5 people, no time limit) or start_trial (14 days, 3 apps), as the person prefers.
name: sign_in
title: Sign in with a work email
